fields.statement: QA at fe1ef0b8d: built ./cmd/rhiza to a scratch path, made a scratch root with projects alpha and beta (each one milestone and two proposed change sets, beta's second depending on its first) and ran the built daemon, paused with max-runs 0, serving the web UI on 127.0.0.1. /p/alpha/roadmap and /p/beta/roadmap each list only their own two change sets. /api/roadmap?all=true (home) and /p/<x>/api/roadmap?all=true return only that project's milestone and 2 change sets, and so do ?project=alpha and ?all=true&project=alpha on beta's API. /p/beta/changes/<beta two> shows Serves beta milestone and Depends on beta change one, and /p/beta/changes/<an alpha change set> answers 404. Failure cases: /p/gamma/roadmap 404, ?all=maybe 400 usage error, POST 405. The CLI's rhiza roadmap --all still lists both projects. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestWebRoot, ./internal/web/... and ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/.*roadmap.*' pass.
